description: SSP2-com-CMIP7 is a global emissions pathway developed within the SSP2 socioeconomic framework, building on the original CGEM-based SSP2-com scenario. The CMIP7 update harmonises emissions with the historical inventories used for CMIP7. National and regional emissions trajectories are constructed to align with 2030 and 2035 NDC targets and longer-term net-zero commitments, while maintaining consistency with global NDC benchmarks and global net-zero emissions objectives. Sectoral emissions are provided for 17 CGEM regions. Run with prescribed carbon dioxide emissions (for prescribed carbon dioxide concentrations, see `SSP2-com-CMIP7`).
